info.description: API for managing prompts and generating AI Share of Voice reports.

tags.description: User-defined tags for categorizing this prompt

brandWebsite.description: The brand's website — a domain (nike.com) or a full URL. A URL with a path (e.g. https://www.nike.com/golf) scopes the analysis to that page; mentions are tracked against its domain either way.

manualPrompts.description: Optional list of custom prompts to include in the report

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the report was created

ReportPromptSnapshot.description: Per-prompt snapshot of raw mention data from a report. Consumers compute SoV and other derived metrics.

promptValue.description: The prompt text that was evaluated

totalRuns.description: Number of evaluation runs for this prompt

MentionsSummary.description: Aggregated mention counts for a prompt across its evaluation runs.

mentionsTotal.description: Total brand + competitor mentions across all runs

brandMentionsTotal.description: Number of runs where the brand was mentioned

competitorMentionsTotal.description: Total count of individual competitor mentions across all runs (a single run mentioning 3 competitors counts as 3)

mentionsTopK.description: Top-K competitor entities ranked by mention count

count.description: Number of runs where this entity was mentioned
Number of times this URL was cited

website.description: Brand's website — a hostname or a full URL. A URL with a path (e.g. https://www.nike.com/golf) is analyzed as given; the returned website is always its domain.

brandName.description: Optional brand name hint. If omitted, inferred from the domain.

maxCompetitors.description: Maximum number of competitor suggestions. 0 disables competitor generation entirely.

maxPrompts.description: Maximum number of suggested prompts. 0 disables prompt generation entirely.

CreateBrandRequest.description: Create a brand. Skips onboarding. The first entry in `domains` is treated as the brand's primary website; the rest are stored as additional domains.

domains.description: Brand domains. The first entry is the primary website; remaining entries are additional domains.

UpdateBrandRequest.description: Update brand-level fields. At least one field must be provided. Provided arrays replace the stored values verbatim. When `domains` is provided, the first entry becomes the primary website and the rest become additional domains. Prompts and competitors are managed via /prompts and /competitors.

domains.description: Brand domains. The first entry is the primary website; remaining entries are additional domains.
Brand domains. The first entry is the primary website; remaining entries are additional domains.

CreateCompetitorRequest.description: Add a competitor to a brand.

UpdateCompetitorRequest.description: Update a competitor. At least one field must be provided. Provided arrays replace the stored values verbatim.

brandId.description: Brand identifier this prompt belongs to

startDate.description: Start of the queried date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: End of the queried date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

citationsTotal.description: Total number of citations across all runs

brandCitationsTotal.description: Number of citations to brand-owned domains

competitorCitationsTotal.description: Number of citations to competitor-owned domains

citedUrlsTopK.description: Top-K cited URLs ranked by frequency

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when no further page exists.

LocalApiProgressCounts.description: Counts are exhaustive: pending + valid + invalid + unknown + blocked equals expected.

LocalAiProgress.description: Local AI is a manual-capture surface. Automated execution is not available.

LocalApiMapResult.description: FOUND and ABSENT_WITHIN_DEPTH are measured rows and include observation, capture time, and evidence provenance. Unresolved rows include a reason code and no rank.

LocalApiMapResultsResponse.description: NOT_INCLUDED has no dataset or items. READY and PARTIAL responses identify their dataset.

LocalApiAiResult.description: A result from the MANUAL_ONLY Local AI capture workflow. VALID rows include observation, capture time, and evidence provenance; every other result status includes a reason code.

LocalApiAiResultsResponse.description: Local AI results are exposed only from the manual-capture workflow. NOT_INCLUDED has no pilot cycle or items; READY and PARTIAL responses identify their pilot cycle.

LocalApiSignedEvidenceAccess.description: A short-lived signed evidence URL. The TTL is always 600 seconds.

LocalApiUnavailableEvidenceAccess.description: Evidence access is unavailable. No URL is issued; the response preserves the 600-second access policy.

LocalApiEvidenceItem.description: VALID evidence includes a content SHA-256 and capture time. Non-valid evidence never exposes signed access.

LocalApiEvidenceResponse.description: Evidence metadata with either a signed access URL or an explicit unavailable state. Signed URL TTL is always 600 seconds.

LocalApiBadRequest.description: Invalid cycle identifier, cursor, or pagination query

LocalApiUnauthorized.description: A valid bearer API key is required

LocalApiForbidden.description: The bearer API key lacks the required scope or cannot access the tenant

LocalApiCursorStale.description: The collection changed after the cursor was issued; restart pagination.

LocalApiInternalServerError.description: The local visibility read could not be completed

get.description: Returns evidence-aware progress for the Local Maps and MANUAL_ONLY Local AI surfaces. Requires the `local:read` bearer API scope.
Returns cursor-paginated Local Maps observations and their evidence references. Requires the `local:read` bearer API scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as `page.nextCursor` by the preceding response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated results from the MANUAL_ONLY Local AI capture workflow. Automated Local AI execution is not available. Requires the `local:read` bearer API scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as `page.nextCursor` by the preceding response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated evidence metadata. Access is either `SIGNED` with a URL valid for exactly 600 seconds or explicitly `UNAVAILABLE`; unavailable evidence never exposes a URL. Requires the `evidence:read` bearer API scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as `page.nextCursor` by the preceding response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of evidence items to return.

200.description: Cursor-paginated evidence metadata with signed or unavailable access

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all prompts across all brands

post.description: Create a new prompt for a brand. This will automatically schedule the prompt for execution.

get.description: Get an aggregated snapshot of mention and citation analytics for a specific prompt over a date range. Use this to identify competitive gaps, track brand visibility trends, and discover top cited URLs.

parameters.name: kMentions
parameters.description: Number of top competitor entities to return in mentionsTopK

parameters.name: kCitations
parameters.description: Number of top cited URLs to return in citedUrlsTopK

200.description: Prompt snapshot with mention and citation analytics

example.promptValue: best running shoes for marathon training

get.description: Retrieve a specific prompt by ID

patch.description: Update a prompt's properties. Only provided fields will be updated. Toggling `enabled` schedules or unschedules the recurring run job.

parameters.name: promptId
parameters.description: The ID of the prompt to update

delete.description: Permanently delete a prompt and cancel all related scheduled jobs. This will also cascade delete all associated prompt runs.

parameters.name: promptId
parameters.description: The ID of the prompt to delete

deletedRunsCount.description: Number of related prompt_runs rows deleted by the cascade.

post.description: Create a new AI Share of Voice report and queue it for generation. The report will evaluate the brand across multiple AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI) using generated and optional custom prompts.

201.description: Report created and queued for generation

reportId.description: Unique identifier for the created report

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all reports, ordered by creation date (newest first).
Poll a report's status. When completed, returns per-prompt snapshot data with raw mention counts. Consumers are responsible for computing SoV and other derived metrics from the raw data.

parameters.name: kMentions
parameters.description: Number of top competitor entities to return in each prompt's mentionsTopK

200.description: Report status and data. When status is 'completed', includes per-prompt snapshot data with raw mention counts.

progress.description: Generation progress percentage (0-100). Available while processing.

prompts.description: Per-prompt snapshot data. Only present when status is 'completed'.

unstable.description: Derived stats (SoV, visibility, etc.). Format may change between versions. Only present when status is 'completed'.

sov.description: Overall share of voice (0-1): brand_mentions / (brand_mentions + competitor_mentions). Null when no mentions at all.

visibility.description: Brand visibility (0-1): brand_mentions / total_prompt_runs (how often the brand appears at all across all prompt runs)

totalPromptRuns.description: Total number of prompt runs across all prompts (each prompt is executed multiple times across different AI engines)

promptsWithBrandMentions.description: Number of prompts where the brand was mentioned in at least one prompt run

promptRunsWithBrandMentions.description: Number of individual prompt runs where the brand was mentioned

sov.description: Share of voice (0-1): this competitor's mentions / total mentions (brand + all competitors)

visibility.description: Visibility (0-1): prompt runs mentioning this competitor / total prompt runs

promptsWithMentions.description: Number of prompts where this competitor was mentioned in at least one run

promptRunsWithMentions.description: Number of individual prompt runs where this competitor was mentioned

competitors.description: Per-competitor SoV breakdown, sorted by SoV descending
